messages.author: edd4914c326b6d31
messages.subject: overlays not working
parts:
p <- ggplot()+xlim(c(0, 1))
m <- 0.2
for (nu in c(2, 4, 7, 100))
p <- p + stat_function(aes(y=0), fun=function(x) dbeta(x, m*nu, (1-m)*nu))
p


Why doesn't this give me a plot that has a plot for each of the nu
values on it? It seems to only show the last one.

I'm also mystified why I need to specify the aes for y to avoid the error
Error in as.environment(where) : 'where' is missing
(I copied from an example).

Thanks.
Ross Boylan

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: overlays not working
parts: not sure what's wrong exactly, but you can do
for (nu in c(2, 4, 7, 100))

p <- p + stat_function(aes(y=0), args=list(nu),
                         fun=function(x, nu) dbeta(x, m*nu, (1-m)*nu))

HTH,

b.
